body:
## 🧩 Scope and resulting behavior

SPN-087 removes the obsolete rail/sidebar fixture implementation left behind by the production Storybook migrations. The retired screen import island and its private styles are unreachable; the only retained import of `mockups.css` was the shared Controls specimen.

- Delete 12 unused prototype TSX files, seven private CSS files, and the 1,966-line `mockups.css`.

- Preserve production Dashboard, EditorFrame, Space, profile, administration, guest states, shared Controls/ThemeMenu, entry styles, all native fixtures and all **1,041 stable story IDs**. The 16 retained `redesign-*` IDs keep their current production/native titles.
- Add an actual same-document Appearance → Controls → Appearance regression. Loading the old stylesheet changed the nested icon picker from block to grid, increased its height by 57px, and changed the selected cover border. The check compares production geometry/styles, verifies document identity and runtime errors, and uses existing readiness and failure diagnostics.
- Remove only SPN-087, append it to `grooming.completed_since`, verify no dependent tickets remain, and regenerate the backlog index.

No production component, permission, navigation, server, token, dependency or design behavior changes. Owners, Collaborators, Operators and Link guests retain their actual production surfaces and access boundaries. There are no remaining visible Redesign examples owned by this ticket.

**Size:** 14,013 counted changed lines, chiefly the coherent obsolete-source deletion and preserved evidence. The maintained [implementation record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/0ed9ef8b23bccbae4f24f4b608a6b55b54c47526/docs/implementation/SPN-087.md) explains the soft-limit decision and inventory. title: ⏳ SPN-110 Expire diagnostic events after seven days
body:
Diagnostic observations currently accumulate until storage fills or an Operator clears them. This adds automatic server-receipt-time expiry, defaulting to seven days, on the existing gated maintenance timer.

body:
## Why

SPN-099 removes the temporary core SDK repair while preserving concurrent Doc editing, native history, link identity and clean installs. This PR implements the renewed single-ticket request. It remains unmerged.

## What changes

- All 23 direct `@univerjs/*` package names across the app/workspaces stay aligned at the published **1.1.0** release. Core ES/CJS builds are verified against their complete official SHA-256 values after installation. The core installer, its obsolete tests, postinstall command and live documentation references are removed.
- `@spinel/sync-transform` installs a shared public native boundary in browser editors, snapshot viewers, confirmed replicas, server models and native test harnesses. Actual custom-range state stays canonical through edits, publication and Undo/Redo.
- The native hyperlink producer's exact local overlapping-retain shape is repaired before command application. Remote, sync-only, mixed-content and opaque shapes retain their existing validation path.
- A DI factory creates the **same exported native Docs manager** with a composed optional UI interceptor. Desktop/mobile IME provider behavior and metadata are preserved. Only paragraph REPLACE retains need isolated history; ordinary typing and Enter keep existing grouping and bounded history.
- The transform layer preserves explicit falsy replacement style keys and explicit empty paragraph intent through slicing across unstyled retains and insertion boundaries. This is not a claim of convergence for every arbitrary paragraph-body conflict. Temporary slice markers cannot reach native apply or the wire.
- The independent Docs composition, UI resize, drawing refresh and Docs UI callback guards remain in place. Their regression suites and retained-drawing/browser obligations remain applicable.

The remaining paragraph REPLACE composition, explicit empty iterator slice, and falsy text-style ownership fixes have been submitted as [Univer PR #7987](https://github.com/dream-num/univer/pull/7987), head `b066a6279beac38db1b0d32377bfbc98d6f32bc7`, against upstream dev `4e6a56e45c8647d9741139af7ebf2f725945d7f3`. The contribution is open and unmerged; it does not establish that a published SDK contains these fixes.

The official **1.3.1** audit still found the relevant core defect forms, and [upstream PR #7938](https://github.com/dream-num/univer/pull/7938) remains open. Qualifying unchanged 1.1.0 through the ticket's stock-behavior adaptation rule avoids coupling core removal to an unrelated drawing/offline SDK upgrade. This PR does **not** claim a newer SDK migration.

Implementation decisions, all four persona effects, old-to-new regression coverage and precise native/IME evidence scope are maintained in [SPN-099.md](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f4e7db978a553a0dcc286937503de87b79ee9d06/docs/implementation/SPN-099.md).

## Verification checkpoint
